status_and_exposure: Recheck ten sourced ST intervals, six opening-status records, dated industry coverage and reported ETF exposure. All signal/opening grouping and source-bound proxy limits stay unchanged; record remaining quality flags and passive exposure changes.
activation: Activate source dates regardless of return direction only after source binding, exact reconstruction, old-input parity, full fitting, fixed forecasts, independent account/paper and status checks pass. risk: Balanced attack, 8% warning, original high-water mark, latched non-recovering risk, existing stricter position cap; use the whitepaper for confirmed contest rules. No extra alpha candidates or relaxed gates.
